pages.title: Five voices
pages.text: Earth shatters. Fire attunes. Water binds. Spirit manifests. Air lends motion. Place the needed totem within 8 blocks of the station; missing voices pause work safely.

pages.title: Chalk and conductor
pages.text: Mark two totems with Ritual Chalk to link them within 16 blocks. A Conductor moves Pulse through linked totems and routes Song Bench items through nearby Ancestral Caches.

pages.title: Ancestral Cache
pages.text: A local 54-slot inventory for camp supplies. Hoppers and item pipes work normally. A redstone signal locks access and automation. A comparator reads how full it is.

pages.title: Deep Cache
pages.text: A personal 54-slot vault shared between your Deep Caches. Visiting The March attunes you; otherwise opening costs 5 Pulse. A Wayfarer Satchel opens the same personal vault.

pages.title: Spirit Cistern
pages.text: Stores 16 buckets of one fluid. Buckets and standard fluid pipes both work. Redstone locks filling and draining, including remote relays. A comparator reads fullness.

pages.title: Wireless cargo
pages.text: Place an item or fluid relay above its source inventory or tank. Use the Lattice Tuner on a destination face, then on the relay. Sneak-use the tuner to replace a previous mark.

pages.title: Cargo tiers
pages.text: Local relays reach 32 blocks. Longreach relays reach 128. Astral relays have no distance limit and can cross dimensions. Transfers cost 4, 8 or 16 Pulse per successful beat.

pages.title: Cargo rhythm
pages.text: Each second, a relay moves up to 16 items or 250 mB. Both ends must already be loaded. Unloaded or full destinations pause safely. Relays never keep distant chunks loaded themselves.

pages.title: Cargo controls
pages.text: Redstone pauses a relay. Comparator: 0 unlinked, 1 linked but waiting, 15 transferring. Lock the receiver with redstone when you need a remote stop. Bound links survive pickup.

pages.title: Pulse to FE
pages.text: The Pulse Adapter converts 1 Pulse into 100 FE, up to 20 Pulse each second. It buffers 16,000 FE and exports to standard energy receivers. Redstone stops conversion and extraction.

pages.title: Redstone language
pages.text: High signal pauses workshops, conductors, resonators, collectors, relays and braziers; it locks storage and travel destinations. The Drumheart instead listens for rising edges to make beats.

pages.title: Read the camp
pages.text: Comparators read stored Pulse, inventory or fluid fullness, FE buffer, and relay activity. A pause keeps stored resources intact. Use clocks, levers and comparators to choreograph the camp.
